description: Enable a VRV zone when the current time is equal to or later than the scheduled start time and the floor occupancy status is active, or when the zone is manually overridden ON via the BMS front‑end
independent_variables: time of day >= scheduled start time

description: Disable a VRV zone when the current time is equal to or later than the scheduled stop time and 25 minutes have passed after the floor occupancy status became inactive, or when the zone is manually overridden OFF via the BMS front‑end
independent_variables: time of day >= scheduled stop time

description: Set the FCU zone temperature to a fixed setpoint of 22.5 °C when the floor occupancy status is ON and either the people count exceeds 5 or the café window is open
Allow the FCU zone temperature to float within the range 20 °C‑24 °C under all other conditions
independent_variables: floor occupancy status OFF or (people count ≤ 5 and café window closed)
dependent_variables: FCU zone temperature allowed to drift between 20 °C and 24 °C

description: Start a warm‑up cycle by fully opening the outside‑air damper when ambient temperature is below 20 °C, average indoor temperature is more than 2 °C above ambient, and the zone is calling for heating; revert damper to minimum position once zone temperature reaches 22 °C
dependent_variables: damper returns to minimum when zone temperature = 22 °C

description: Start a cool‑down cycle by fully opening the outside‑air damper when ambient temperature is above 16 °C, average indoor temperature is more than 2 °C below ambient, and the zone is calling for cooling; revert damper to minimum position once zone temperature reaches 22 °C
dependent_variables: damper returns to minimum when zone temperature = 22 °C

description: Modulate the outside‑air damper position based on zone CO₂ concentration: keep damper at minimum until CO₂ reaches 600 ppm, then open proportionally up to maximum at 800 ppm
dependent_variables: outside‑air damper position (minimum until 600 ppm, proportional up to maximum at ≥800 ppm)

description: Activate heating mode when zone temperature is lower than the setpoint by more than the deadband
Activate cooling mode when zone temperature is higher than the setpoint by more than the deadband
Enable an AC unit when zone temperature exceeds 28 °C or when manually overridden ON via the BMS front‑end
Disable an AC unit when zone temperature falls below 28 °C or when manually overridden OFF via the BMS front‑end
Generate a BMS alarm when a fault signal is received via the Daikin gateway
independent_variables: fault signal received via Daikin gateway

description: Generate a BMS alarm when the café window is opened or kept open after the scheduled operating hours
independent_variables: café window opened after set hours
